name: What is the typical timeline from initial consultation to project completion for kitchen remodeling in Orange County?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical timeline from initial consultation to project completion for kitchen remodeling in Orange County?

acceptedAnswer.text: For kitchen remodeling projects in Orange County, the timeline from initial consultation to completion typically ranges from 4 to 12 weeks, depending on the scope. Design and planning can take 1-4 weeks, especially for custom elements. Material selection and ordering add another 2-6 weeks. Actual demolition and construction, including cabinet and countertop installation, usually take 2-4 weeks. We work diligently to keep your project on schedule while maintaining high quality standards.
acceptedAnswer.description: In Orange County, kitchen remodeling projects typically take 4-12 weeks from consultation to completion, depending on scope and custom elements.
